advisories.impact: remote unauthenticated process termination when an application opens an affected WebSocket connection to a malicious or compromised peer
remote process termination from malformed permessage-deflate data on an affected WebSocket connection
downstream response splitting or corruption when the undici retry interceptor is used in a framing-sensitive forwarding path

exposure_assessment.reason: The vulnerable bundled component is present in the pinned Node runtime, but the sealed 0.6.76 server uses Node built-ins only and the bounded exact-image scan finds no server-side WebSocket construction or undici retry-interceptor use. The tracked September 4 advisory surfaces are therefore not currently reachable in WFM server code.

containment: block server-side WebSocket client use while process.versions.undici is below 6.28.1
block undici retry-interceptor use while process.versions.undici is below 6.28.1
retain built-in fetch because the tracked September 4 advisories require the affected WebSocket or retry-interceptor surfaces
do not add a third-party undici package merely to mask the vulnerable bundled component

regression_test.expected: fail closed if a tracked vulnerable surface becomes reachable

remediation.preferred: when an approved digest-pinned Node 22 image bundles undici >=6.28.1, update the Node image only through normal exact-candidate integrity, regression, browser and hosted-proof gates
remediation.current: surface-level containment is deterministic and reversible; no production mutation is required
